with source_rows as (
    select
        raw_data,
        filename,
        loaded_at,
        try_to_timestamp_tz(raw_data:as_of::string) as tick_ts,
        raw_data:product_id::string as product_id,
        raw_data:feed_status::string as feed_status,
        raw_data:reason::string as feed_reason,
        try_to_number(raw_data:data_age_ms::string) as data_age_ms,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:highest_bid:price::string, 38, 12) as bid_price,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:highest_bid:quantity::string, 38, 12) as bid_qty,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:lowest_ask:price::string, 38, 12) as ask_price,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:lowest_ask:quantity::string, 38, 12) as ask_qty,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:current_spread::string, 38, 12) as spread,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:max_spread_since_start::string, 38, 12) as max_spread_since_start,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_mid_price:"1m":value::string, 38, 12) as avg_mid_price_1m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_mid_price:"5m":value::string, 38, 12) as avg_mid_price_5m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_mid_price:"15m":value::string, 38, 12) as avg_mid_price_15m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:forecast_60s:value::string, 38, 12) as forecast_value,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:forecast_60s:naive_value::string, 38, 12) as forecast_naive_value,
        raw_data:forecast_60s:model::string as forecast_model,
        raw_data:forecast_60s:status::string as forecast_status,
        try_to_timestamp_tz(raw_data:forecast_60s:target_at::string) as forecast_target_ts,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:primary_1m:value::string, 38, 12) as primary_aae_1m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:primary_5m:value::string, 38, 12) as primary_aae_5m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:primary_15m:value::string, 38, 12) as primary_aae_15m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:naive_1m:value::string, 38, 12) as naive_aae_1m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:naive_5m:value::string, 38, 12) as naive_aae_5m,
        try_to_decimal(raw_data:average_absolute_error:naive_15m:value::string, 38, 12) as naive_aae_15m
    from COINBASEPOC.INGEST.RAW_STREAM
)
select
    sha2(concat_ws('|', coalesce(filename, ''), coalesce(tick_ts::string, ''), coalesce(product_id, '')), 256) as snapshot_id,
    tick_ts,
    product_id,
    bid_price,
    bid_qty,
    ask_price,
    ask_qty,
    (bid_price + ask_price) / 2 as mid_price,
    spread,
    max_spread_since_start,
    avg_mid_price_1m,
    avg_mid_price_5m,
    avg_mid_price_15m,
    forecast_value,
    forecast_naive_value,
    forecast_model,
    forecast_status,
    forecast_target_ts,
    primary_aae_1m,
    primary_aae_5m,
    primary_aae_15m,
    naive_aae_1m,
    naive_aae_5m,
    naive_aae_15m,
    feed_status,
    feed_reason,
    data_age_ms,
    filename as source_filename,
    loaded_at
from source_rows

select
    snapshot_id,
    tick_ts,
    product_id,
    bid_price,
    bid_qty,
    ask_price,
    ask_qty,
    mid_price,
    spread,
    max_spread_since_start,
    avg_mid_price_1m,
    avg_mid_price_5m,
    avg_mid_price_15m,
    forecast_value,
    forecast_naive_value,
    forecast_model,
    forecast_status,
    forecast_target_ts,
    primary_aae_1m,
    primary_aae_5m,
    primary_aae_15m,
    naive_aae_1m,
    naive_aae_5m,
    naive_aae_15m,
    feed_status,
    feed_reason,
    data_age_ms,
    source_filename,
    loaded_at
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.STAGING.stg_coinbase__market_snapshots
qualify row_number() over (partition by product_id, tick_ts order by loaded_at desc, source_filename desc) = 1

with checked as (
    select
        snapshot_id,
        tick_ts,
        product_id,
        bid_price,
        ask_price,
        spread,
        feed_status,
        source_filename,
        loaded_at,
        count(*) over (partition by snapshot_id) as snapshot_id_count
    from COINBASEPOC_PROD.STAGING.stg_coinbase__market_snapshots
)
select snapshot_id
from checked
where tick_ts is null
   or product_id is null
    or feed_status is null
   or source_filename is null
   or loaded_at is null
   or snapshot_id_count > 1
    or (
         feed_status = 'healthy'
         and (bid_price is null or ask_price is null or spread is null)
    )

select
    date_trunc('hour', tick_ts) as hour_ts,
    product_id,
    count(*) as unhealthy_tick_count,
    count_if(feed_status <> 'healthy') as non_healthy_tick_count,
    count_if(data_age_ms > 1000) as latency_anomaly_count,
    approx_percentile(data_age_ms, 0.50) as data_age_p50_ms,
    approx_percentile(data_age_ms, 0.95) as data_age_p95_ms,
    approx_percentile(data_age_ms, 0.99) as data_age_p99_ms,
    min(tick_ts) as first_anomaly_at,
    max(tick_ts) as last_anomaly_at
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
where coalesce(feed_status, 'unknown') <> 'healthy'
   or data_age_ms > 1000
group by 1, 2

with forecasts as (
    select
        snapshot_id as forecast_snapshot_id,
        product_id,
        tick_ts as forecast_issued_at,
        forecast_target_ts,
        forecast_model,
        forecast_value,
        forecast_naive_value
    from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
    where forecast_status = 'ready'
      and forecast_target_ts is not null
), matched as (
    select
        f.*,
        actual.mid_price as actual_mid_price,
        actual.tick_ts as actual_at
    from forecasts f
    left join COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks actual
      on actual.product_id = f.product_id
     and actual.tick_ts = f.forecast_target_ts
)
select
    matched.forecast_snapshot_id,
    matched.product_id,
    matched.forecast_issued_at,
    matched.forecast_target_ts,
    matched.actual_at,
    matched.forecast_model,
    matched.forecast_value,
    matched.forecast_naive_value,
    matched.actual_mid_price,
    abs(matched.forecast_value - matched.actual_mid_price) as primary_absolute_error,
    abs(matched.forecast_naive_value - matched.actual_mid_price) as naive_absolute_error,
    iff(sign(matched.forecast_value - mid_at_issue.mid_price) = sign(matched.actual_mid_price - mid_at_issue.mid_price), true, false) as primary_directional_hit,
    iff(sign(matched.forecast_naive_value - mid_at_issue.mid_price) = sign(matched.actual_mid_price - mid_at_issue.mid_price), true, false) as naive_directional_hit
from matched
left join COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks mid_at_issue
  on mid_at_issue.product_id = matched.product_id
 and mid_at_issue.tick_ts = matched.forecast_issued_at

select
    date_trunc('hour', tick_ts) as hour_ts,
    product_id,
    count(*) as tick_count,
    avg(spread) as average_spread,
    min(spread) as minimum_spread,
    max(spread) as maximum_spread,
    stddev_samp(spread) as spread_stddev,
    avg(mid_price) as average_mid_price,
    sum(mid_price * (bid_qty + ask_qty)) / nullif(sum(bid_qty + ask_qty), 0) as quantity_weighted_mid_price_proxy
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
group by 1, 2

select ask_price
from (select * from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks where feed_status = 'healthy') dbt_subquery
where ask_price is null

from (select * from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks where feed_status = 'healthy') dbt_subquery
where bid_price is null

select feed_status

where feed_status is null

select mid_price
from (select * from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks where feed_status = 'healthy') dbt_subquery
where mid_price is null

from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
where product_id is null

select snapshot_id

select tick_ts

from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks

select snapshot_id
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
where abs((ask_price - bid_price) - spread) > 0.000001

select
    snapshot_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from COINBASEPOC_PROD.CORE.market_ticks
where snapshot_id is not null
group by snapshot_id
having count(*) > 1

select hour_ts
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.feed_health_log
where hour_ts is null

select product_id
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.feed_health_log
where product_id is null

select
    date_trunc('hour', forecast_issued_at) as hour_ts,
    product_id,
    forecast_model,
    count(*) as forecasts_issued,
    count(actual_mid_price) as forecasts_with_actual,
    avg(primary_absolute_error) as primary_mean_absolute_error,
    avg(naive_absolute_error) as naive_mean_absolute_error,
    avg(iff(primary_directional_hit, 1.0, 0.0)) as primary_directional_accuracy,
    avg(iff(naive_directional_hit, 1.0, 0.0)) as naive_directional_accuracy
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.forecast_accuracy
group by 1, 2, 3

select forecast_issued_at
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.forecast_accuracy
where forecast_issued_at is null

select forecast_snapshot_id
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.forecast_accuracy
where forecast_snapshot_id is null

select forecast_snapshot_id
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.forecast_accuracy
where actual_at is not null
  and actual_at <> forecast_target_ts

select
    forecast_snapshot_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.forecast_accuracy
where forecast_snapshot_id is not null
group by forecast_snapshot_id
having count(*) > 1

select
    s.hour_ts,
    s.product_id,
    s.tick_count,
    s.average_spread,
    s.minimum_spread,
    s.maximum_spread,
    s.spread_stddev,
    s.average_mid_price,
    s.quantity_weighted_mid_price_proxy,
    coalesce(h.unhealthy_tick_count, 0) as unhealthy_tick_count,
    coalesce(h.data_age_p95_ms, 0) as data_age_p95_ms
from COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.spread_stats_hourly s
left join COINBASEPOC_PROD.MARTS.feed_health_log h using (hour_ts, product_id)
